decision.explanation: The question 'When was Stanley F.C. established?' refers to Accrington Stanley F.C., which has a complex history involving distinct entities. Source D1S4 states the 'current club was formed in 1968' while the 'original Accrington Stanley' was founded in 1891. Source D3S4 presents a conflicting account stating the 'current club was formed in 1975' (seven years after the 1966 collapse), also referencing the original 1891 founding. Source D4 confirms the original club was established in 1891. Since the documents provide competing assertions for the establishment date of the 'current' incarnation (1968 vs 1975) and both are explicitly supported by the text as the formation date of the entity existing at the time of writing, all three dates (1891 for the original, 1968 and 1975 for the current) are valid complementary answers reflecting the ambiguity and distinct historical phases described in the sources.
